description: 🚀 I'm an Electromechanical Engineering student at ENSAM Casablanca, passionate about aerospace, robotics, embedded systems, and space exploration. I have hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, Python, MATLAB, and CAD. I'm looking for creative, motivated teammates with skills in aerospace, programming, electronics, robotics, 3D design, or simulation. Let's combine our skills, innovate, and inspire the next generation of space explorers! 🌍
